replacement.sketch: No resource change required: Court/reporter artifacts and compatibility reports are data computations. The pinned vocabulary is the subject; no filesystem, database or network layer is acquired.

No resource change required: Footnote spans are computed from inline text; marker detection has no filesystem or external parser process. Preserve the original source string and span boundary subject.
No resource change required: Entity construction, codec equivalence and schema annotations are pure data operations. Patent and party fixtures do not acquire a database or platform service.
No resource change required: Legal transitions are schema values, not executed legal workflows. Acts, rights and priorities acquire no resource or shared service.
No resource change required: Markdown sections and claim dependencies are parsed in memory. The large hostile range and repeated claims are bounded input controls, not a provider or file acquisition.
